label: PF Backlog 587
title: EDP-06: Baseline performance capture (artifact list/read, project load/save, run transitions, memory retrieval, job claim/lease, DB/pool counts)
body: Part of EPIC BI-PF-1292. Source: docs/Product_Forge_Enterprise_Performance_Security_DB_Storage_Roadmap.md. Phase item (see epic). Language rule L1 = Go; must pass scripts/dev/language_rule_review.py.

brief.problem: No measured performance baseline for core data-plane operations.
brief.what_adds: Reproducible Go benchmark harness + baseline report artifact.
brief.why: EDP optimization phases need before/after numbers to prove wins.
brief.who_feels: Platform team, SREs, and enterprise customers feeling slow artifact/project ops.

objective: Capture reproducible baseline performance metrics for artifact list/read, project load/save, run transitions, memory retrieval, job claim/lease, and DB/pool counts.
acceptance_criteria: Harness benchmarks all 6 operation groups with p50/p95 latency
Baseline report emitted as versioned artifact
Metrics stored via BI-PF-1294 observability path
in_scope: Go benchmark harness + baseline report artifact
approach: Scenario-driven harness hitting stable APIs; results written as artifact.
risks: API churn from BI-PF-1507/1297 refactor invalidating baselines
Baseline numbers unrepeatable without pinned environment
rollback: Retire harness job; baselines are additive artifacts with no runtime dependency.
evidence: Candidate APIs enumerated in item candidates

analysis.implementation_strategy: Build a Go benchmark harness that drives existing artifact/project/run/memory/job APIs, recording latency/throughput/pool metrics; emit baseline report artifact via existing artifact_store; reuse candidate /api/v1/artifacts and dogfood run endpoints.
dependency_findings: REQUIRES BI-PF-1294 (EDP-02 observability) for metric plumbing
RELATED BI-PF-1293 ADR for storage decisions
conflict_findings: Potential conflict with BI-PF-1307 which refactors /artifacts API; sequence harness before refactor or pin endpoint contract
duplication_findings: No existing perf-baseline harness in components
BI-PF-1307 refactors /artifacts API later — harness must use stable endpoints only
analysis.rationale: New harness component but fully reuses existing APIs and artifact store for output; no duplicate work in backlog.
assumptions: BI-PF-1294 delivers metrics collection before this item
Benchmark env is representative enough for relative comparisons
risks: API churn from BI-PF-1507/1297 refactor invalidating baselines
Baseline numbers unrepeatable without pinned environment
evidence: Candidate APIs enumerated in item candidates

consolidation_proposal.title: EDP-06: Baseline performance capture (artifact list/read, project load/save, run transitions, memory retrieval, job claim/lease, DB/pool counts)

acceptance_criteria: Baseline harness records p50/p95/p99 for artifact list/read, project load/save, run transitions, memory retrieval, job claim; plus connection counts and CPU/RAM/disk.
Results stored as evidence and reproducible in CI/release.
ADR document committed covering storage layers, backends, and data-flow decisions
Develop commit SHA pinned and recorded
The 11 interfaces are declared with explicit optional capabilities (versioning/lock/conditional-write/KMS/signed-URL/multipart).
A conformance suite runs against any adapter (starting with WorkerGrid's store as reference).
No domain module depends on a concrete provider.

context_review.reason: Endpoints and artifact store exist; env and retention are human decisions.
